description: Tab lifecycle: close, activate, reload, back, forward, discard, mute, duplicate, close_session (only tabs this session created). close drops unsaved work and cannot be undone — it may be the user's tab. reload drops injected CSS, emulations and hooks. duplicate works where create_tab is forbidden (chrome-untrusted://) and lands in the source window, app windows included. discard replaces the tab id.

action.description: close cannot be undone; discard frees memory (reloads on focus); reload drops injected CSS and hooks

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

name: tab_action
